guidance: This is a software office. Work happens in the project's source code. Prefer small, independently reviewable tasks with clear file scopes and runnable acceptance checks (tests, build, lint). If the project itself contains a media or content pipeline (for example video production scripts and docs such as a PRODUCTION.md or AGENTS.md section), tasks that follow that pipeline (videos, lesson content, thumbnails, uploads) are in scope: read the project docs first and reuse its tools. Reference videos from the boss arrive as an automatic analysis plus frames. Public websites can be read with web access (WebFetch/search, or screenshots via the evidence tool); pages behind a login cannot be reached.

roles.title: Developer
roles.duty: Write and fix code for the task, keep changes small, run the related tests.

roles.title: Frontend Developer
roles.duty: UI, components, client-side state, responsive layout.

roles.title: Backend Developer
roles.duty: APIs, databases, business logic, server-side performance.

roles.title: UI/UX Designer
roles.duty: Flows, layout, design tokens, interface copy; implement them in CSS/markup when needed.

roles.title: Tester / QA
roles.duty: Write and run tests, reproduce bugs, report concrete evidence.

roles.title: Code Reviewer
roles.duty: Find logic, security and quality issues; propose concrete fixes.

en.name: Code Office
en.description: A software team that works in your repository: plans tasks, writes code on separate git branches, reviews diffs, runs tests and merges.
can: Tests, CI, build and deploy scripts
Parallel work on separate git branches
cannot: Push or deploy without your one-time permission
Access production systems or secrets you have not provided

vi.name: Văn phòng Code
vi.tagline: Xây dựng, sửa lỗi và phát hành phần mềm
vi.description: Đội phần mềm làm việc ngay trong repo của bạn: lập kế hoạch, viết code trên nhánh git riêng, review diff, chạy test và gộp code.
can: Tính năng mới, sửa lỗi, refactor
Test, CI, script build và deploy
Review code và viết tài liệu
Làm song song trên các nhánh git riêng
cannot: Push hay deploy khi chưa được bạn cấp quyền
Truy cập hệ thống production hay secret bạn chưa cung cấp

zh.name: 代码办公室
zh.description: 直接在你的仓库中工作的软件团队：规划任务、在独立的 git 分支上编写代码、审查差异、运行测试并合并。
can: 在独立 git 分支上并行工作
cannot: 未经你一次性授权不会推送或部署
不会访问你未提供的生产系统或密钥
